newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures gain late, finish higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures gain late, finish higher.

text.p: June 18 - Most U.S. debt futures edged to fresh session peaks late and ended up. One trader said institutional buying in Sept T-bonds pulled it to 112-8/32 high. Others cite technical followthrough after Fed's beige book. Trade called moderate late. Resistance at 112-10/32, the 4-month high, traders said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
